method_count_interpretation: Nonexclusive explicit-method signals, not an exhaustive primary-method taxonomy. Counts may overlap and must not be summed to 100%. Absence of a signal does not establish absence of a method. One methods review is excluded from primary fieldwork.
temporal_inference: Qualitative within-journal same-issue-number reading of question development; no publication-growth or whole-discipline trend estimate is made. Contemporary study outcomes and historical publication dates are not treated as the same time series.
coverage_claim: All 273 enriched research records informed comparison; paragraph citations are concrete supports, not a claim that every paper endorses the synthesized argument.
